title: Coming to New Orleans and working at the Villa
summary: He first came to New Orleans in 1915, went back when the district closed, and played the Villa and with Frankie Dusen and Jack Carey.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Ah, I see. Yeah. When did you first come to New Orleans? I came...
I came... Well, I came in 1915 and I went back.
How long were you here then?
Well, I just told the district closed down, you know.
I mean, when you first came here that time.
Well, I came here, I went back after the district closed down. Oh, I see.
You must have been here quite a while, weren't you?
I said, no, it was 1915, I think. Oh. I came, yeah. And you went back? I went for Wooden Central Bank, you know. And that's why I'd been knowing Manny, you know. Yes.
Where did you work when you moved down in the district then? Where did you play there? At the Villa.
At the Villa. Yeah. You did your first job when you moved to the city. No, I played around the city.

I played with Frankie Duesen and Jack Carey, you know. I played, you know, in the... What did you play then? Your... The spring clarinet. Your clarinet. Yeah, the spring clarinet. Then I made records with Louis Domaine, you know, with the tenor sax. Oh, yes.
